_comment: Compute table for the report. infer_ms_per_video is measured by eval/measure_compute.py and must come from ONE machine (_machine below) to be comparable. train_s is wall-clock training seconds for one seed and must be supplied by whoever trained the model: python -m eval.measure_compute --train-s gru=4200. 0 means the model has no training phase; null means not recorded yet. Parameter counts come from the prediction files, not from here.
_machine: macOS-27.2.1, arm, python 3.14.2, numpy 2.5.5, torch 2.15.0, device cpu
